description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a data model `Item` and a route handler for updating an item via HTTP PUT. It uses Pydantic models for data validation and FastAPI's body parameter for request parsing.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic data model representing an item with fields for name, description, price, and tax, with validation rules.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Annotated[Item, Body(embed=True)])
methods.description: An asynchronous route handler for updating an item, accepting path parameter `item_id` and request body `item`, returning a JSON with item details.

ctags.name: price
ctags.pattern: /^    price: float = Field(gt=0, description="The price must be greater than zero")$/

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Annotated[Item, Body(embed=True)]):$/
